answer: Unlike the fable of free infinite clones, PoA gates rewards behind a per-epoch semantic challenge: each identity must publish an original 120–600 character answer that embeds three unpredictable seed words, with duplicate hashes rejected on-ledger. Peers attest only coherent mechanism essays, so a whisper farm of templates earns nothing. To farm a haven of payouts an attacker must generate distinct, high-quality answers for every fake identity every epoch—paying continuous model inference and human review time that grows linearly with sybil count while failed grades yield zero emission.
